preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10.
Number of nodes N is between 2 and 200,000.
Number of main roads M is between 0 and 120,000.
Nodes x, y, and S are between 1 and N.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= d <= N - 1 for d in distances)
postconditions.description: Each distance in the output is between 0 and N-1.

postconditions.expression: distances[i] == min_village_roads(S, i + 1) for i in range(N - 1)
postconditions.description: Each distance corresponds to the shortest number of village roads from S to the respective node.
